sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 was used for 1 transaction(s) totaling $74.96, beginning with transaction 3478561 ($74.96, online channel). The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's established pattern and is classified as card not present new device. Graph analysis linked the involved device profile and payment card to related activity on other cards within the same window, indicating a common origin across accounts. The cardholder was asked to validate the activity; the recorded response supported unauthorized use. Based on the exposure exceeding $1,000 and the connection to other compromised cards, the bank files this report on the described activity. Affected transactions: 3478561.
